description: Google on Tuesday announced Short Video Overviews for NotebookLM, its AI-powered research assistant and knowledge base builder. The feature, as the name suggests, allows users to generate concise videos leveraging AI. The Mountain View-based tech giant says it can summarise uploaded sources in a minute using narrative explanations and educational animations. The feature builds upon Google’s steady transformation of NotebookLM from a simple AI-powered research assistant into a more versatile learning tool in recent months.
title: Google Announces Nano Banana 2 Lite-Powered Short Video Overviews for NotebookLM

description: The UK's Competition and Markets Authority has proposed new rules that could require Apple to let developers direct users to third-party payment options and expand access to the iPhone's NFC technology. The proposals aim to increase competition, lower costs for developers, and create more payment choices for users. They could also enable UK fintech firms to build alternatives to Apple Pay. Apple opposes the proposals, while Google says it has already introduced changes that address some of the regulator's concerns.
title: Apple May Be Required to Allow External App Payments, Third-Party NFC Access in UK: Report

description: Redmi K90 Ultra has been launched in China today as the latest entrant in the company's K series. It has a 6.83-inch display with up to 165Hz refresh rate and includes an 8,550mAh Battery with 100W wired fast charging support. It packs up to 512GB storage alongside up to 16GB RAM. The handset has a Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset and a dual rear camera setup, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary sensor.
title: Redmi K90 Ultra Launched With Snapdragon 8 Elite Chipset, Cooling Fan and 8,550mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

title: Best Wi-Fi Laser Printers for Small Offices: Wireless Printing Without the Cable Clutter

description: Ubisoft has detailed console specifications for Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced. The game will support Performance, Fidelity, and Balanced modes on PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X. Black Flag Resynced will support ray-tracing features across all modes.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Console Specs, PS5 Pro Enhancements Confirmed

description: The US Securities and Exchange Commission has secured a $5.4 million court judgment against NanoBit Limited and its affiliates over a crypto investment fraud scheme that targeted at least 18 investors between 2023 and 2024. The ruling follows allegations that the defendants used fake investment platforms, misleading social media promotions, and WhatsApp groups to deceive investors into transferring funds, which were instead diverted to the scheme's participants.
title: US SEC vs NanoBit: Regulator Wins $5.4 Million Judgment in NanoBit Fraud Case

description: The OnePlus N6 is not the most powerful phone in its segment, and fortunately, it does not pretend to be either. Instead, it is built around practicality. The overall package somewhat justifies OnePlus's need for another series in its portfolio. With the OnePlus N6, the company has targeted those who want a reliable smartphone that lasts as long as possible on a single charge without sacrificing the software experience. So, if battery life ranks above everything else on your priority list, the OnePlus N6 makes a compelling case for itself.
title: OnePlus N6 Review: The Most Focused OnePlus Phone in Years

description: Apple released the new security fixes earlier than anticipated to adapt to the new reality, as AI enables faster “development of malicious hacking tools”, the company told Reuters. The company reportedly said that it wants to reduce the time between the first public release of an update and the rollout of the stable version to users. With this, Apple could be looking to give bad actors less time to find vulnerabilities, even before it is released to a wider user base. The company usually releases major security fixes with bigger OS updates, while reserving the smaller updates for other bug fixes, unless a new security flaw is discovered after the OS version has been rolled out.
title: Apple's iOS 26.5.2 Release With Security Fixes Was Accelerated Due to Advances in AI Hacking Tools: Report

description: Samsung has reportedly confirmed that the next-generation Galaxy Ring is in development and hinted that future versions could support iPhones. The company is said to be focusing on software and AI-powered health services rather than hardware upgrades alone. Upcoming Samsung Health features include Vitals, Heart Health Score, and personalised AI health coaching. Samsung also plans to expand its connected health ecosystem through SmartThings integration while continuing work on technologies such as non-invasive glucose monitoring and advanced wearable health features.
title: Samsung Galaxy Ring 2 Reportedly in Development, Could Arrive With iPhone Support

description: Microsoft could be putting third-party Xbox Game Pass deals "on pause". According to an industry insider, developers have said that their negotiations with Microsoft for Game Pass deals have been on hold. Xbox is also bracing for layoffs and studio shutdowns in July.
title: Xbox Has Reportedly Paused New Third-Party Game Pass Deals

description: Oppo Reno 16 will be powered by an octa core Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset in India, the smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. Interestingly, its Chinese counterpart is equipped with an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8550 Super SoC. On top of this, the company has revealed that the handset will ship with various new AI-powered tools, including the AI Recording Sticker, AI Scan, AI Voice Translation, AI Menu Translation, AI Bill Manager, and AI Mind Pilot. Users will be able to trigger these AI tools by tapping the dedicated AI Snap Key. The Oppo Reno 16 will run on Android 16-based ColorOS 16.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Confirmed to Launch With a Snapdragon Chip in India, Unlike Its Chinese Counterpart

description: Nothing Phone 4b has been spotted in leaked real-life images. The images revealed that the upcoming smartphone will be available in India in black, purple, and white colour options, apart from the blue shade that the company recently confirmed. The leaked images suggest that the handset will be powered by Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset. The phone might also ship with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of internal storage. The Nothing Phone 4b was spotted with the Nothing OS 4.1, which is based on Android 16.
title: Nothing Phone 4b's Key Specifications Spotted via Leaked Real-life Images, Could Feature 6,000mAh Battery

description: Germany has emerged as the leading jurisdiction for crypto licensing under the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation, accounting for 57 authorised crypto-asset service providers ahead of the July 1 deadline. ESMA’s interim register also shows France accelerating approvals in recent days, while several EU member states are yet to issue a single MiCA licence, highlighting uneven adoption of the bloc’s unified crypto framework.
title: Germany Takes Lead in Europe’s MiCA Crypto Licensing With 57 CASPs Ahead of Deadline

description: If you are looking to buy a new monochrome laser printer for your office or other official purposes, there are multiple options available in the market. Reputable brands like HP, Canon, and Brother offer some of the best monochrome laser printers in India. title: Best Monochrome Laser Printers for Office in India in 2026 From HP, Canon and More

The new handset was launched in select global markets, including India, on June 25. The Galaxy A series phone is scheduled to go on sale in India on July 3 via the Samsung online store. It is backed by a 5,000mAh battery with support for 25W wired fast charging.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G Price in India Revealed Days After Launch: Key Specifications, Features

The footage suggests the smartphone retains a design similar to the iPhone 17 Pro, with a triple-camera rear setup, a LiDAR sensor, and flat sides. The videos are reportedly timestamped to early 2026, indicating the device could be a prototype. Apple has not confirmed the authenticity of the footage or announced the iPhone 18 series.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Rear Design, New Colourway Spotted in Purported Drop Test Video

The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is tipped to feature a dual rear camera unit comprising two 50-megapixel sensors. The Galaxy Z Flip 8 will reportedly retain the 50-megapixel main camera and 12-megapixel ultrawide sensor of the Galaxy Z Flip 7. Samsung is said to be updating its camera supply chain for the upcoming foldable lineup.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra to Get 50-Megapixel Ultrawide Camera, No Camera Upgrades for Galaxy Z Flip 8: Report

description: Bitcoin traded near $59,500 on Tuesday as investors weighed easing US-Iran tensions against weak institutional demand and expectations of higher US interest rates. Analysts said Strategy’s planned Bitcoin sale, the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook, and upcoming US jobs data have kept risk appetite subdued. At the same time, Bitcoin continues to hold above key support despite the recent market correction.
title: Bitcoin Price Slides to $59,500 as US Fed Signals, Strategy's Turnaround Plans Weigh on Sentiment

description: Acer has launched the TravelLite TL24-54M business laptop in India with Intel's new Core Series 3 processors built on the Intel 18A process node. The laptop features a 14-inch Full HD Plus display, support for up to 64GB of DDR5 RAM, PCIe Gen4 SSD storage, Wi-Fi 7 connectivity, and enterprise security features. It also includes an aluminium chassis, MIL-STD 810H certification, and Acer FlexiCharger technology. Acer has not yet announced the laptop's price or sale date.
title: Acer TravelLite TL24-54M Launched in India With Intel Core Series 3 Chip, 14-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

The Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipsets are expected to be announced at the Snapdragon Summit. The  Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset is expected to be used in upcoming OnePlus 16, iQOO 16 and Xiaomi 16 series.
title: Qualcomm Schedules Snapdragon Summit 2026 for September: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Series Expected to Debut

description: iPhone Ultra could launch in September alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models. A new dummy iPhone Ultra model has leaked online, offering an early glimpse of the design. The final design could still change before launch. The renders show the phone with a wider form factor and in a black shade. It appears to have a dual rear camera unit and a Camera Control button. The cameras are arranged in a pill-shaped camera module on the back.
title: iPhone Ultra Dummy Unit Surfaces in Black Colourway, Offering a Closer Look at Its Design

description: Files leaked on the dark web by a ransomware group include supplier lists, component details and photos said to show Apple’s future iPhone 18 Pro models. The data was reportedly stolen from Tata Electronics in India. The breach could expose Apple’s closely guarded supply chain, affect its relationship with Tata, and give competitors and counterfeiters valuable information about production.
title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Supplier List, Parts and Photos Exposed in Tata Data Leak

description: Apple has said the Competition Commission of India (CCI) relied too heavily on complaints from rivals and did not carry out an independent investigation before concluding that the company broke competition rules. In a June 25 filing, Apple asked for the findings to be cancelled. The case is part of Apple's dispute with India's Competition Commission over alleged unfair practices on its iOS app platform.
title: Apple Accuses CCI of 'Copy-Pasting' Rivals' Claims in Antitrust Investigation

description: OnePlus N6 has been launched in India as the first N series smartphone from the company. The new entry-level smartphone is set to go on sale in the country soon via Amazon. The OnePlus N6 will be available for purchase in Fresh Mint and Midnight Green colour options. An octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6360 Apex chipset. The handset is equipped with an 8,000mAh battery, too. The new OnePlus N6 ships with support for 45W wired fast charging and 6.5W wired reverse charging. It features a single 50-megapixel camera on the back and an 8-megapixel camera on the front for selfies and video calls.
title: OnePlus N6 Launched in India With 8,000mAh Battery, Dimensity 6360 Apex Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: Apple has reportedly acquired key assets of Rabbit 3 Times, the company behind the Play app, which won the Innovation category at the 2025 Apple Design Awards. The deal surfaced through a European Commission filing published after the mandatory waiting period under the Digital Markets Act. The agreement also allows Apple to hire some employees. Play has since been removed from the App Store, and its technology could eventually be integrated into Xcode or other developer tools.
title: Apple Acquires Rabbit 3 Times, Developer of 2025 Apple Design Award-Winning 'Play' App

description: State of Decay 3 developer Undead Labs is reportedly facing closure amidst a major round of cuts at Xbox. The company is set to shut down several studios and announce layoffs in July, and a new report claims Undead Labs is among the studios at risk of closure.
title: State of Decay 3 Developer Undead Labs Reportedly Facing Closure Amidst Xbox Cuts

description: iQOO 16 Ultra may not launch as the company reportedly plans to skip the Ultra model.  This suggests that the iQOO 16 lineup will be launched without an Ultra model. The new lineup could include the standard iQOO 16 and iQOO 16T models succeeding last year's iQOO 15 and iQOO 15T, respectively. The iQOO 15 Ultra was released in China in February this year with a 6.85-inch 2K AMOLED display with up to 144Hz refresh rate. title: iQOO 16 Series to Launch Without Flagship iQOO 16 Ultra Model, Tipster Claims

description: Google's Pixel Watch 5 has reportedly appeared in US FCC filings, revealing four suspected variants with LTE, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, NFC, Ultra Wideband, and satellite SOS support through NTN Band 23 and Band 255. According to a recent report, the certification documents also reference multiple watch straps, suggesting the devices are smartwatches. The filings raise questions about Google's lineup, as all four variants appear to support LTE. The smartwatch is expected to debut alongside the Pixel 11 series later this year.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 FCC Listing Reveals UWB, LTE Connectivity and Satellite SOS Support

The flagship OnePlus 15 and OnePlus Pad 4 are expected to come with bank offers, while prices of the OnePlus 15R, OnePlus Pad Go 2, and the recently launched OnePlus Nord Buds 4 will also be slashed.
